# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c23 P4](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0004), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls (maternally)  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Author, journalist, and magazine short-story writer  <sub>[v4 c23 P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c25 P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian is a tall, broad-shouldered, exceptionally handsome man with dense brown hair, a sharp nose and chin, and expansive, luminous dark-gray eyes. His ears are noted for their pleasing shape, and his teeth are bright and visible when he smiles. When not smiling, his face carries a somber, sorrowful, and distracted expression.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P4](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0004), [v4 c23 P7](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0007), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010)_

## Personality

Adrian is enthusiastic, candid, amiable, and imaginative, possessing a keen wit and deep appreciation for romantic storytelling and natural beauty. When absorbed in his creative work or reflecting, he can appear like a prophet or someone beholding visions. He is artistically minded and intensely dedicated to his writing projects.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006), [v4 c25 P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 c25 P13](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0013), [v4 c38 P18](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0018), [v4 c38 P26](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0026), [v4 c38 P33](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0033)_

- To write a major Canadian novel based on authentic theme and spirit  <sub>[v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

## History

Adrian Treleaven traveled to Seven Gulls for a three-month break to recover his strength and seek inspiration for a major Canadian novel. Upon arriving, he was driven by Miss Winifred to Nell Carrow's home, where he was introduced to Lorna Vane, his prospective landlady, and was immediately struck by her extraordinary beauty. Recognizing his literary talent and maternal connection to the area, Nell introduced him to Captain Saul. Adrian proposed writing Captain Saul's "life-book," weaving the captain's maritime adventures together with the romantic thread of his lost love, Margaret.

Over the summer, Adrian set up a workroom in the lighthouse next to Captain Saul's room, throwing himself passionately into writing the book while relying on the captain's knowledge of local seafaring lore. In his afternoons and evenings, he joined Nell, Hugh Carrow, Captain Saul, and Lorna on shore excursions, clambakes, fishing trips, and fireside gatherings. During his stay, Adrian fell deeply in love with Lorna Vane. In late August, in the flower-filled garden of the ancient dwelling, he confessed his love to Lorna, and they pledged their devotion to one another. Before departing, he attended a final gathering by the driftwood fire where Captain Saul bestowed a blessing upon him, Lorna, and their friends.

## Background by volume

- His mother was born and raised at Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)</sub>
- His grandfather built the ancient dwelling at Seven Gulls and waited for the Royal William  <sub>[v4 c23 P4](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0004), [v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c23 P12](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0012)</sub>
- Grandson of Captain Saul's closest companion, the old schoolmaster  <sub>[v4 c25 P7](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0007)</sub>
- Worked for a newspaper and composed magazine short stories prior to visiting Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

## Quotes

> You cannot realize how delighted I am to be here, Mrs. Carrow. I have a strange sensation of returning home.  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)</sub>

> I—I have never witnessed anyone quite like her. I was not ready—I had not anticipated—good lord, a person DOES NOT anticipate a goddess as a landlady!  <sub>[v4 c23 P28](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0028)</sub>

> We shall work together. The soul will be provided by you and the body by me. Oh, Captain Saul, a renowned book will be authored by the two of us. And our labor will commence immediately.  <sub>[v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)</sub>

> On certain nights an odd smell drifts along the breeze in this garden, resembling a ghostlike scent. From which exact flower it originates, I have never managed to find out. It is evasive, lingering, and remarkably sweet.  <sub>[v4 c38 P2](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0002)</sub>

> Are you able to foresee what lies ahead within the flames, Captain Saul?  <sub>[v4 c38 P13](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0013)</sub>
